items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that the Gysin homomorphism is well defined on rational equivalence classes at source lines 3732-3737, label lemma-gysin-factors, whose proof occupies source lines 3739-3760. The proof is short but not a citation: it unwinds rational equivalence into a locally finite sum of divisors on integral closed subspaces, builds the coproduct of those subspaces together with its induced Cartier divisor, and uses the compatibility of Gysin pullback with proper pushforward, together with the known descent of rational equivalence along a proper pushforward, to reduce to an integral space carrying the divisor of one rational function. The two remaining cases are then settled by two different identifications of the Gysin pullback with Chern class caps, one of which is the zero map. The counted statement records neither the coproduct reduction nor the case distinction.
